key_path: zero-account: POST https://claimable.neon.tech/v1/agent/identity {type:anonymous, capabilities:[postgres,data_api,auth], source:<agent>} returns identity_assertion + project
exchange the assertion (jwt-bearer grant) at /v1/oauth2/token for a bearer token; GET /v1/projects/{id}/credentials returns DATABASE_URL (or CLI: `neon claim create` writes .env)
later: `neon claim accept --no-open` / POST /claim returns a verification_uri_complete; human signs in and accepts the transfer (code TTL 900s, project TTL 72h)
with an account: `npm i -g neon && neon login` (browser OAuth) then `neon api-keys create` mints an API key from the CLI
MCP: `npx neon@latest mcp` (writes config for detected agents) or the Claude connector directory, OAuth
human_gates: browser sign-in only to claim / for a permanent account

agent_native_auth.cli_device_flow: yes: `neon login` browser OAuth (`neon auth` legacy alias); NEON_API_KEY / --api-key for headless
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes: `neon api-keys create` / API key endpoints; org and project-scoped keys
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes: org/project-scoped API keys. MCP read-only scope chosen at OAuth consent, plus ?readonly, ?projectId, ?category URL params
agent_native_auth.claimable_anonymous: yes, best in class: Claimable Neon (https://neon.com/auth.md). Anonymous agent identity, a 72h Postgres project with Data API and Auth, device-code-style claim transfer that rotates DATABASE_URL

remote.auth: OAuth DCR or API key bearer

mcp.local: `npx neon@latest mcp` installer; `neon plugins` bundles MCP + skills
mcp.type: product (projects, branches, SQL, migrations, inspect_database diagnostics) + docs resources
mcp.one_click: official Claude connector (Browse connectors > Neon); config generator; CLI installer into all agents; unauthenticated tool listing at https://mcp.neon.tech/api/list-tools

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://neon.com/llms.txt (opens with agent routing: 'If the user cannot create an account right now, follow Claimable Neon')
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes: append .md or send Accept: text/markdown
docs_for_agents.openapi: Neon API v2 OpenAPI (https://neon.com/docs/reference/api.md links the spec)

score_justification: An agent can get a working Postgres connection string over plain REST in seconds with no account, then hand ownership over via a device-code claim. The CLI mints API keys, and the MCP has DCR plus scoping params.
best_practice: auth.md: a spec-like, agent-addressed provisioning procedure (anonymous identity, jwt-bearer token, credentials, device-code claim) that is reachable straight from llms.txt
biggest_gap: Unclaimed projects die at 72h and DATABASE_URL rotates on claim, so the agent must re-fetch credentials. The domain move from neon.tech and the CLI rename from neonctl to neon may confuse agents trained on older data
